claim: Tesla expects to deliver 2.2 million vehicles in 2026.
summary: As of the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, there is no verifiable public record of Tesla issuing official guidance expecting 2.2 million vehicle deliveries in 2026. Tesla had stopped providing precise annual delivery guidance, and no such figure can be confirmed without tools.

sub_claims.text: Tesla has issued an official expectation or guidance for 2026 vehicle deliveries
sub_claims.stated_text: Tesla expects to deliver 2.2 million vehicles in 2026
sub_claims.note: No public Tesla guidance document, earnings call transcript, or filing confirming a 2026 delivery expectation is established in available knowledge without tools.

sub_claims.text: Tesla's expected 2026 vehicle delivery volume is 2.2 million
sub_claims.note: The specific figure of 2.2 million cannot be verified as Tesla's stated expectation without external evidence; Tesla does not have a confirmed public forecast of this amount as of knowledge cutoff.
